findings.title: Broch Sphere SVG clipped at 390px — right half invisible
findings.description: The Broch Sphere SVG has `min-w-[720px]` on the SVG element inside an `overflow-hidden` wrapper. At 390px viewport, only the leftmost ~390px of the 980px graph renders; Homer's Iliad, 2001, Interstellar, Tolkien, the Story Lineage sector, and the CULTURAL/PERSONAL sector labels are all invisible. The graph is non-navigable at mobile — the user cannot see the cross-strand Transfer Events or right-hemisphere nodes.
findings.fix: Replace `overflow-hidden` wrapper with `overflow-x-auto` and add a scroll affordance label at mobile. Alternatively reduce SVG viewBox to 760×440 at mobile via a container-query-aware width and keep graph 2-column on xl+.

findings.title: Observatory hero heading oversized at mobile (text-6xl = 60px, 3 lines)
findings.description: The Observatory heading `text-6xl md:text-7xl` renders at 3.75rem (60px) at 390px. 'xPRIMEray Observatory Gallery' wraps to 3 lines, consuming ~250px — roughly 30% of the 844px mobile viewport before any content. No `sm:` size is defined, so mobile gets the same large size as mid-tablet. Should use clamp() or a lower base size.
findings.fix: Replace with `text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl` or use CSS clamp: `[font-size:clamp(1.875rem,7vw,4.5rem)]`.

findings.title: Fractal Inspiration Atlas unavailable at mobile — component error
findings.description: At 390px, FractalInspirationAtlas renders an error banner 'Fractal Inspiration Atlas unavailable — see browser console for details.' followed by a blank dark page. This is likely a WebGL/canvas initialization failure at narrow viewport in the headless test environment, but the fallback state is a silent blank page. The component has no graceful degraded state for narrow viewports.
findings.fix: Ensure FractalInspirationAtlas error boundary surfaces a useful message and a 'View on desktop' nudge at mobile widths. The hardcoded dark canvas bg (from-[#05070f]) is a separate finding (F-09).

findings.title: Atlas sub-nav strip: 9px mono text, no annotation plate, sub-44px touch targets
findings.description: The Atlas secondary navigation ('ATLAS | OBSERVATORY | QUATERNION | INSTRUMENTS | XENOCITATIONS | ATLAS | LINEAGE | GET INVOLVED') uses `font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em]` with no background plate. In light mode the labels are near-invisible against the page background. The strip uses `h-9` (36px) container — touch targets are below the 44px WCAG 2.5.5 minimum. Current active tab appears only as `text-foreground/60` vs `text-muted-foreground` — insufficient state differentiation.
findings.fix: Apply `.instrument-strip` class to the container div (already defined in index.css). Raise tab min-height to 44px. Floor label size to `text-[10px]`. Strengthen active-tab indicator.

findings.title: Home hero mono subtitle near-invisible in light mode
findings.description: The Atlas/Home hero subtitle 'MEASURED OBSERVABILITY CUTSHEETS FOR NATIVE GEODESIC RAY TRACING.' uses `text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest` with amber color at low opacity. In light mode, amber on white has insufficient contrast. In dark mode it is decorative/atmospheric and acceptable, but in light mode it effectively disappears — the computed contrast of amber-500/60 on white is approximately 1.8:1.
findings.fix: In light mode, bump the opacity to at least 0.80 and ensure the amber token (`--annotation-amber`) on white meets AA-large (3:1). Current `--annotation-amber` in light is `28 90% 40%` which gives ≈4.1:1 on white — use the token instead of raw amber-500.

findings.title: Atlas floating labels ('OBSERVER DISAGREEMENT', 'OFFAXIS_OBSERVE_DELTA', 'DOMINANT TRANSITION') have no backing plates
findings.description: Multiple mono labels on the Atlas hero section float directly on the gridded page background without any annotation plate. In dark mode they read acceptably due to the low-contrast grid and dark field. In light mode the grid is more visible and the labels wash out — 'OFFAXIS_OBSERVE_DELTA' on the right barely distinguishable from the grid at laptop-1366.
findings.fix: Wrap each floating label span in `.annotation-plate` (already in index.css). The class provides `hsl(var(--layer-panel-strong) / 0.82)` background with border and 3px border-radius — exactly what's needed.

findings.title: Broch Sphere node label backing plates near-invisible in light mode
findings.description: The SVG node label backing rects use `fill='hsl(var(--layer-panel)/0.88)'`. In light mode, `--layer-panel` is `0 0% 100%` — pure white at 88% opacity on the `--layer-diagram` field (`220 12% 96%`). The plate is white-on-near-white; the backing provides no visual separation from the diagram grid. The stroke is `hsl(var(--border)/0.22)` which in light mode (border: `220 14% 78%`) at 22% opacity is essentially invisible. Labels remain text-readable but lose their annotation-plate function.
findings.fix: Increase stroke opacity from 0.22 to 0.55 in light mode. Best: add a CSS class `.broch-label-bg` on the rect and override in `html.light`: `fill: hsl(var(--layer-panel-strong)); stroke-opacity: 0.55;`.

findings.title: OpsStatusBar sub-9px text at opacity 0.40–0.45
findings.description: OpsStatusBar uses `text-[8px]` and `text-[8.5px]` at `text-muted-foreground/40` to `text-muted-foreground/45`. At 8px with letter-spacing these are below practical reading threshold (~10px minimum for decorative mono labels). The `muted-foreground/40` in dark mode gives computed luminance well below AA. These are atmospheric labels, but at mobile they compete with navigable content.
findings.fix: Floor all sizes to `text-[9px]` minimum. Use `text-[9px]` uniformly for the label strip. Opacity floor: 0.55 for dark, 0.72 for light mode.

findings.title: FractalInspirationAtlas canvas hardcoded near-black gradient in light mode
findings.description: The fractal canvas container uses `bg-gradient-to-br from-[#05070f] via-[#070912] to-[#04050b]` — hardcoded near-black hex colors with no `html.light` override. In light mode, this renders as a dark rectangle inside the otherwise white page, creating a jarring light/dark mismatch. The canvas itself renders dark content (fractal nodes) that is designed for a dark field, but the surrounding panel contrast is wrong.
findings.fix: Replace hardcoded gradient with `bg-[hsl(var(--layer-diagram))]` as base, or add `html.light` CSS override: `.fractal-canvas { background: hsl(var(--layer-diagram)); }`. The fractal node rendering colors may also need a light-mode pass.

findings.title: Broch Sphere graph: 'Homer's Iliad / Odyssey' and '2001: A Space Odyssey' label chips overlap
findings.description: Two nodes (star-homer at lon≈242°/lat≈80°N and s-2001 at lon≈248°/lat≈65°N) have nearby coordinates that map to adjacent pixel positions in the 2D projection. Their backing-plate label chips overlap: 'Homer's Iliad / Odyssey' (21 chars × 6.5 + 10 = 147px wide) and '2001: A Space Odyssey' (21 chars = similar width) collide horizontally, making both labels hard to read.
findings.fix: Separate node positions: shift s-2001 longitude by ~15° or adjust star-homer latitude. Alternatively add a label-offset mechanism for nodes within 50px of each other on the projected plane.

findings.title: Broch Sphere layout single-column below xl (1280px) — right panel and node card off-screen at 1024px
findings.description: The `xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_380px]` layout only activates at 1280px. At 1024px (laptop-sm) and below, the right column (Journey panel + Stance toggle + Node card) stacks vertically below the SVG. The SVG graph already fills most of the 768px viewport height (h-[520px]), pushing all interactive panels off-screen. The stance-reading comparison — the primary curiosity feature — requires scrolling past the graph to reach.
findings.fix: Lower grid breakpoint from `xl:` to `lg:` (1024px), or reduce SVG height at `lg:` to `h-[420px]`. This lets the right panel co-exist with the graph at 1024px.

findings.title: Observatory amber badge uses raw Tailwind amber-500 in light mode instead of token
findings.description: The Observatory badge uses `text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400`. In light mode `amber-500` = `hsl(38 92% 50%)` — contrast on white is ~2.1:1, failing AA for text. The semantic `--annotation-amber` token in light mode (`28 90% 40%`) achieves ~4.1:1. The `dark:` modifier pattern bypasses the token system.
findings.fix: Replace `text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400` with `text-[hsl(var(--annotation-amber))]`. One change covers both themes correctly.

findings.title: Wide viewport (1920px+) shows excessive empty space on all pages
findings.description: At 1920px+ pages use `container` (max-w-1400px) with `mx-auto`. The content column is ~1400px and flanked by ~260px empty gutters on each side. The Observatory and Atlas sub-navs do not expand beyond their max-width, leaving large band of background on both sides. This is expected behavior for a max-width container, but the gutters feel especially hollow at ultra-wide and the background gradient looks thin.
findings.fix: No code change required. The cosmic background gradients provide sufficient ambience at wide viewports. Monitor at ultra-2560 for specific sections that break visually.
